story.title: The Saint-Tropez Double
story.subtitle: A film producer’s screen test is really an audition for a political impersonation.
story.premise: producer Vivienne Marchal's private screen test for a Riviera thriller called The Second Face brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Vivienne Marchal; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.

characters.title: Costume designer

characters.invitationPromise: Vivienne promised you credit and ownership of the minister’s transformation wardrobe.
characters.privateIdentity: You realized the measurements were copied from a real statesman.
characters.privateObjective: Prove your designs were misused without surrendering ownership.
characters.privateSecret: You concealed a fitting card to protect the actor named on it.

solutionSteps.title: The impossible casting
solutionSteps.truth: Vivienne was recruiting a double for a visiting minister, not casting a film.

solutionSteps.title: The face behind the camera
solutionSteps.truth: Dario Vescari killed Vivienne because she discovered he planned to replace the minister permanently.

openingSteps.title: Receive Anaïs Morel
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Anaïs Morel to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Anaïs Morel: Announce that the costume measurements belong to a public figure, not any actor present.

openingSteps.title: Receive Peter Sloan
openingSteps.trigger: After Anaïs Morel completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Peter Sloan to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Peter Sloan: Repeat one sentence in two identical voices and say the production is not what it claims.

openingSteps.title: Receive Dario Vescari
openingSteps.trigger: After Peter Sloan completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Dario Vescari to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Dario Vescari: Present yourself as the film’s investor and demand the screen test proceed despite Vivienne’s doubts.

openingSteps.title: Receive Inès Laurent
openingSteps.trigger: After Dario Vescari completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Invite Inès Laurent to deliver only the prepared opening fact. Inès Laurent: Point out that the “locations” form a real motorcade route and ask who commissioned it.

openingSteps.title: Discover the host
openingSteps.trigger: After Inès Laurent completes their cue
openingSteps.instruction: Cue Gabriel Neri, stage Vivienne Marchal's off-page collapse without contact, announce the discovery, and become Game Master. Gabriel Neri: Enter in the minister’s posture, then break character and ask why everyone looks frightened.

host.name: Vivienne Marchal
host.title: Vivienne Marchal, film producer and covert talent scout; then Game Master

story.solutionSummary: Dario financed the screen test to place his own operative as the minister’s double. Vivienne learned the substitution was intended to last beyond one public appearance and gathered witnesses. Dario killed her before the final test and exploited everyone’s film-industry secrets as alternate motives.

clues.text: The camera marks correspond to a minister’s public route, not a film scene.
Dario approved a costume before the supposed lead actor was selected.
Vivienne promised each guest a different reward for helping expose the substitution plan.
The cottage rehearsal matched the minister’s gait and signature gestures.
Dario knew the double was meant to survive the appearance when everyone else expected one performance.

acts.title: The fatal interruption
acts.operatorGoal: Establish producer Vivienne Marchal's private screen test for a Riviera thriller called The Second Face, stage the single no-contact death, then become Game Master.
acts.playerGoal: Deliver only your short prepared cue and wait for the body to be discovered before bargaining begins.

setupRequirements.label: Confirm that the entire opening is spoken and staged without contact.
